reviews.text: Very nice and helpful owner with a lot of knowledge about (luxury) dog and cat food. She sources a large part of her assortment from Italy, so it is a good place for anyone who wants to surprise and amaze themselves (and their pet). Accessories can be found on the first floor, as well as a very sweet French Bulldog and Boston Terrier.

What an adorable and cute shop to find gifts to bring home to your furry friends. Elisa is so passionate about pets and her shop and you feel this throughout your visit. My place to go to in Amsterdam.
Very kind and welcoming owner of the store. Knows the products by heart. Helped me pick out a cute and tasty birthday cake for my cat 🫶🏻 …
Great range of products, great quality, great service, will come again soon

Excellent shop! The owner helped me pick food, treats and toppers for my two extremely picky whippets - patient and really knowledgeable. She stocks brands you don't see everywhere, like Pala, plus The Skinny Dog Collective, the best sighthound wear out there. And the toy selection! Best dog store in Amsterdam :)
Amazing service and products!
A wonderful place with quality and exclusive items, plus the service from the girl who was very friendly and professional.
This place is heaven and the owner has a big and warm heart for you and your Animals ❤️ a rare gem in Amsterdam

Delightful small pet boutique, selling a variety of high grade, good quality pet food and general care products for both cats and dogs. Has a toy section on the upper floor. Absolutely recommend a visit to pet owners living nearby

Really nice small business in Amsterdam owned by Elisa!
She cares deeply about food quality because her own dog suffered from allergies and itchiness. Because of this, she personally sources every single brand in her shop. You’ll mostly find high-quality Italian brands, but she also carries PALA, dry BARF options (like Mr. Bones), and excellent wet food! Even the toys and treats are sourced with immense care.

I highly recommend supporting this wonderful local business! 🐾

Elisa was really lovely! I forgot my puppy’s kibble at home and needed emergency food for dinner. She explained everything clearly and was incredibly helpful. I’ll definitely be coming back again! 😊 …
Amazing customer service and great selection of items! I could find something perfect for my dog's birthday and I got some free goodies too :) thanks so much <3
Super nice owner and a great assortment of everything for your cat or dog 🐕❤️🐈 …

The store has many brands that you usually can’t find around here easily and Elisa was incredibly kind! There’s a big selection of leashes and treats so we’re definitely coming back when we’re in Amsterdam!
Really nice Pet Shop, a lot of variety, good quality, many many cool products, if you want something special for your dog or cat, pay a visit 😇 …
kindest owners, super great advice!!!

Today Pongo and I visited Pet Emporium! I’ve always wanted to check out the store since I live in the neighborhood, but I never did because I didn’t have a dog. Now that I have Pongo, I finally wanted to visit. As soon as I walked in, I was welcomed with a smile and such a warm feeling. The owner talked to me, explained things, and helped me find what I needed for Pongo. The store is full of the best-quality products! I’m super happy and will definitely come back again whenever Pongo needs something

I just went to get some dog treats for one of my clients and the lady, such a sweetheart, gave me a bunch of freebees to try out, for the dogs that I watch over. So so sweet! I will definitely recommend her and this place. The products are really good and worth the price.

Some of their products is shipped from Italy. And a cute little extra is that they sell birthday treats. I'm excited to try those out for animal day and my clients their dogs birthdays. All and all a good experience!
Really nice selection of food, treats and toys. Also, the people here are super friendly and knowledgeable. I will be back again soon!
Very good organic foods and accessories! So many options ❤️

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Some places are shops.
Pet Emporium is an experience.

First I walked in four years ago, by chance, and ever since then this tiny store on Tsaar Peterstraat has lived in my memory like a small, warm light. This week I finally returned with my dog Jazy-Blue and within seconds it felt like a celebration as Jazy was spoiled the whole time like she had her birthday 😊

What makes this place so special is the intention behind everything. Nothing here is random. Every bag of food, every toy, every accessory has been chosen with knowledge, care, and a deep respect for animal wellbeing. Elisa doesn’t just sell products, she understands them. You can feel how much she thinks about what is truly good for the animals.

And yet it never feels serious or clinical, it’s joyful, colourful, full of charm. I kept telling I had to leave, at least ten times… and then I would discover something new and stay a little longer. Again. And again.

Years ago I even found insect-based kibble here and carried it all the way to Suriname for my opossum rehab, that’s how unique her selection four years ago already was and is.

In a world of big, anonymous pet stores, this shop is something rare: personal, warm, deeply knowledgeable, and genuinely kind. We were welcomed like old friends. We walked out with beautiful things to test, a lovely keychain, and the unmistakable feeling that animals truly come first here.

Pet Emporium is not just one of my favourite pet shops, it’s a place that makes you happy the moment you step inside.

Thank you, Elisa, for creating something so special for us and our fur kids. I’m already looking forward to the next visit ✨♥️🐾
I visited yesterday while on holiday and the lady Elisa was so helpful and kind. There was lots of variety of all things for dogs and the pricing was great. Very happy i stopped by ☺️

I think this is a “gem” pet shop! The owner is super helpful and friendly. I found pet brands that I have never seen before and are super healthy and environmentally friendly.
It is far from my house but the have an online shop 😉

I happened to find this hidden gem by chance, since my cat has being diagnosed with possible food allergy and the veterinarian food prescribed by my vet was not of his tastes (nor mine - very bad smell) I decided to do some research and look for better quality food as opposed to the usual commercial brands that my vet prescribed (Hills or royal canine). I wanted real food no hydrolised food that in the process seems to lose its taste and smell.

So I started to do research on ‘novel protein’ food and this is how I found out about the Pet Emporium!

This shop is amazing! Not only you can find huge variety of food for both dogs and cats but there is also special diet food as well as ‘single protein’ options. What I love about the store is that the owner has a lot of good brands, many of which are Italian, which made me feel much better considering the fiasco with all other commercial brands.

The owner, Elisa, is very friendly and very good at making recommendations. I managed to pick up few tins of new food for Leo and also very nice treats (single protein too!) which Leo has already tried out and loves!

Thank you for your help Elisa and also for the extras samples I got which I can’t wait to try out as part of his trial diet.. will keep you posted! 🐾🐾

Lovely, quaint pet store. We visited last month and just happened upon this place. Being dog lovers ourselves, we found Eliza to be very helpful and personable. Will definitely come back on our next trip to Amsterdam.
Super nice shop with a lot of choice! I'm going to come here more often!

Amsterdam's BEST pet store! 🤩 All of the products I love for my dog - best quality, lots of options and with friendly & knowledgeable service on top.
Thank you Elisa 😘 …

Thank you Elisa!
We bought a new harness for Moppie and went home with many yummy gifts 💕 …
Lots of nice things that I had only seen online before. We left with a snack for the dog and a new long leash. Found a new permanent home!

Such a lovely store with a lot of brands and variety. I love that everything is sourced with care and precision. The staff is so friendly! The owner Elisa was very helpful and had great recommendations for my dog. Thank you Elisa!

I absolutely love this pet shop! The owner is such a wonderful and kind girl, not only is she super friendly and always ready to help, but she’s also a true animal lover with two dogs of her own. What I admire most is that she supports animal shelters, which says a lot about her heart and dedication.

The shop itself is fantastic, fully stocked with high-quality pet food, clothes, accessories, and all kinds of dog supplies. I just bought two dog necklaces here and even had them engraved - they turned out amazing!

It’s the perfect place if you want great products, personal service, and the warm feeling of supporting someone who genuinely cares about animals. Highly recommend! 🐾❤️

The staff here are incredibly kind and helpful.

I recently purchased a water bowl, and both my cat and dog absolutely love it. The design is not only practical but also very stylish, which makes it a great addition to my home.

Also, I’m impressed by the selection of brands they carry — thoughtful, high-quality choices that show the shop really cares about pets and their owners.

Definitely a pet store worth recommending!

It is one of those stores that many people miss these days: a small business with a character. Apart from a wide selection of food, toys, care items and what’s not, the owner provides excellent client service and extra touch for the pets.

Very nice store, owner is super helpful!
Many of the accessories for dogs have a neat design. 100% recommend
I just bought toys for my cat, great selection and pricing but the best part was the lovely service and help provided by Elisa. 11/10
Great shop! Always nice to stock up on kibble and pick up a little extra. The quality is high, and the owner is fantastic!

Best store ever!
We are here on holiday and the owner was very kind and helpful. Since our dog needs a rather rare dog food brand, we were lucky to find this place online and preordered the kibble for pickup. If you are looking for a shop with high quality pet food, accessories and much more - this is the place to go!
Very pleasant help from someone who clearly knows what she is talking about!

Superb shop with a huge selection, the owner is incredibly kind and her little dog is a sweetheart. We received excellent advice and brought back treats and toys for our Staffordshire Bull Terrier and Shih Tzu that they absolutely loved!

10/10 experience , we stayed in hotel nearby and decided to stop in to pick up something nice to bring home for our pets.
the owner was so friendly asking us what breed any allergies etc and gave us a few freebies for our boys to try!! All we could think about the whole holiday was when we could get home too see the reactions & They loved everything as expected!! We also met a dog called frankie on the walk back from the shop who had just been groomed next door and we shared a treat with her. Thanks for the amazing experience!!
The best Pet Shop in Amsterdam!❤️

I think Frida and I found a fave shop for doggies in Amsterdam. Great selection of good-quality food supplements and fun add-ons, you’ll hardly find elsewhere. Elisa, the owner, is super sweet and will help you with your choice (Frida absolutely loved her as she was willing to make her test some treats ☺️) and she knows her loyal customers by name.

Definitely not cheap, but the products are/look (for those Frida hasn’t had the time to test) so great that it is impossible to regret your shopping haul. Well will definitely come back when we come to Amsterdam again.

The place is amazing and it is visible that it is done with soul and passion. The owner is very friendly and the variety of toys and snacks for pets is incredible! Not having a dog myself, i will come again and again still, to buy presents to my friend’s pets 🤍 …

I had a wonderful experience at Pet Emporium in Amsterdam today. Elise was incredibly helpful and genuinely took the time to assist me. She gave thoughtful and honest advice, especially regarding the needs of my anxious dog. It was clear she really cared and was thinking along with me to find the best solutions for the specific challenges I was facing. I left with exactly what I needed—and a very good feeling. The service felt truly sincere, and I highly recommend all pet owners to go and visit! I will definitely be coming back soon.

We are traveling with dog from outside of Netherlands and we’re looking for good quality dog food. This store has amazing selection of dry and wet food, different brands, and even home-made pate!

Lovely lady suggested us what will fit best and gave our dog Pepito tons of pets :-)

He definitely enjoyed the store!
Perfect selection of good quality food and other stuff. Very friendly owner! Recommended!
Thank you, so kind and helpful will be back again on the next trip x

Eliza has a heart of gold and genuinely cares about your pet’s well-being. She takes the time to understand your needs, gives great advice, and always goes above and beyond. The products are top quality, and she’s super generous with samples and support. It’s rare to find someone this thoughtful and passionate — highly recommend.

One of the best pet shops I've ever visited! The range of products is large and very good, the best firms are selected, which you don't often find in pet shops. It is obvious that the owners of the store not only want to sell the goods, but also to leave customers satisfied and fulfill all their wishes. I recommend this place if you like to pamper your pets.

Just visited today and this shop is absolutely wonderful. Kind, friendly  and helpful owner. Locally sourced and natural products, amazing selection. And two super sweet Bostons to smooch too ! 😍. Highly recommend …
The best pet store with the most courteous owner in the world!
Amazing shop with a very big selection of high quality products. Our go to place in Amsterdam!

A beautifully local independent pet store stocking a verity of brands you just won’t find anywhere else. The owner is super helpful and you can tell just loves dogs.

I wanted to give six stars to the best frenchie in the world, Otto, who can sometimes be found inside ready to give you a hug and put a smile on your face 🐾

I was looking for good quality products in good price and thanks to Elisa I found a shop which provides this.
Plus Elisa, the owner, is so kind with you and also with your little friend
Great service. Lovely place!

Great pet shop! Elisa, the owner, is clearly very passionate about pets and knows how to do her job very well. I was looking for a place where I could ask some questions, with real human contact and support, and she delivered just that. Also, her selection only counts high-quality products! 10/10, recommended.
Amazing pet shop with great supply of pet food from different countries.. not to mention the staff is so sweet and kind.
Pet Emporium is such a wonderful shop for dog owners and dogs! The owner is super friendly and helpful and amazing snacks for our dog!

I was there for the first time today to buy something tasty and healthy for a young cat who visits me daily...

Milk... she loves it.
It was a very successful choice !!!

Wonderful products, a fantastically well-maintained shop, and, no less importantly, the owner is perfectly at home...

If you want your pet to feel, in every sense, that you love him, pay a visit to the Pet Emporium.

Good luck !!!!
One of the best places I've bought dog stuff. The owner is so nice and friendly. I love this store.

The perfect pet store ever visited !!! The lady who attended me was very helpfull with a full of knowledge for all of the things I have asked. Must visit place if you have a dog or a cat !! Highly recommended
Woof woof woof , got a Nice polar bear for sinter Klaas, 5 stars - The dog
The Italian shop clerk was super friendly and generously explained every item I asked about in detail. Would definitely come back :)
Great shop with enough items to provide your pet(s) with everything they need.
I had a great experience, they have a wide selection of quality pet supplies. The staff is super helpful and friendly.
